pages.text: The gold locust eats any mature crop within 32 blocks, and it hardly waits between meals. A field does not last long.$(br2)An adult drops a gold locust snack when killed.
$(item)Breeding$()$(br)Gold locusts eat golden vegetables, and ignore flowers.$(br2)Two gold parents always have a gold child. Any other pair may, one time in a hundred, have one too.
